cells.Read by: The step `Check latest scheduled refresh jobs` of the job `health` (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh-health.yml`).
cells.Values and default: Runner class names with spaces between them. The workflow writes `2x96core 2x72core` when the repository variable `SLICE_REFRESH_2X72_ENABLED` is `true`. Otherwise it writes `2x96core`. Unset: does not occur. The job always defines it.
cells.Effect: The health check (`bin/ci/bench_refresh_health.py`) looks at the runs of `bench-refresh.yml` from the last 14 days. It fails unless each named runner class (one kind of benchmark runner) has a measured and published refresh. The step passes the value without quotes to `bin/ci/bench_refresh_health.py`. Each word becomes one argument of `--expected-runner-classes`. A name that `bin/ci/bench_refresh_matrix.py` does not list stops the health check with `unknown runner class`. Only runs on the default branch count.

hints.problem: Two definitions of runner class. Text A, in `ENABLE_2X72` and `EXPECTED_RUNNER_CLASSES`: "(one kind of benchmark runner)". Text B, in `REQUESTED_RUNNER_CLASS`: "(groups of CI servers of one type)". B is the better text. A class is a hardware type (`2x96core`: 2 CPUs of 96 cores; `2x72core`: 2 CPUs of 72 cores). One `2x72core` runner has no `benchmark` label.
hints.suggested: In `ENABLE_2X72` and `EXPECTED_RUNNER_CLASSES`, replace "(one kind of benchmark runner)" with "(a group of CI servers of one hardware type)".

cells.Values and default: Only the exact text `1` allows the publish. All other text refuses it. The workflow writes `0`. Unset: the same as `0`. The script refuses a feature-branch publish to `testing` and exits with status 1.
cells.Effect: `1` lets a manual run publish a feature branch (a branch other than `main` and `release-*`) to the APT channel `testing` (a package set of the Positron APT server). Tag pushes and the channel `unstable` do not need it. `main` and `release-*` branches are refused for `testing` with any value. A workflow comment says to write `1` only after the APT server keeps `~feature.` versions apart from the test candidates.

cells.Values and default: Directory name without a path. The workflow writes `gcp-nix-<run id>-<run attempt>-<job id>`. Unset: the workflow always defines it. The cleanup step uses `${GCP_NIX_JOB_TEMP_NAME:?}`. An unset or empty value stops its `rm` command with an error.
cells.Effect: It names the temporary directory of one job: `$RUNNER_TEMP/$GCP_NIX_JOB_TEMP_NAME`. The job keeps its Nix result links and other temporary files there. The last step of the job removes the directory. `JOB_TEMP` holds the full path of the same directory. `bin/ci/nix-cache/test_cache.py` sets the name to `job` when it runs 3 steps of the job `tron-build`.

cells.Read by: The step `Reconcile slice refresh health issue` of the job `reconcile` (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh-health.yml`).
cells.Values and default: `healthy`, `stale:<platform names with commas>` or `probe-error:<error name>`. It is the output `report` of the job `health`. Other text counts as no valid report. Unset: the job always defines it. An empty value counts as no valid report.
cells.Effect: `healthy` together with a successful job `health` closes the open GitHub issue `Slice cost-data refresh is unhealthy`. In every other case `bin/ci/bench-refresh-ci.sh` opens that issue or adds a comment to it. The step passes the report and the result of the job `health` to `bin/ci/bench-refresh-ci.sh`. A `stale:` or `probe-error:` report is valid only with the result `failure`. `bin/ci/bench_refresh_health.py` writes the report. The platform names are `genoa96` for the `2x96core` runners and `granite_rapids_6962p` for the `2x72core` runners.

cells.Values and default: Nix store path of the ingest executable, of the form `/nix/store/<hash>-<name>`. It is the output `store_path` of the job `build-ingest`. Unset: does not occur. Both jobs define it.
cells.Effect: The jobs fetch this store path from the Nix binary cache at `REGIONAL_NIX_CACHE` with `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py`. The ingest tests run `<value>/bin/ingest`. The plugin build gets the value as the Nix argument `ingest`. `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py` rejects text that is not a Nix store path of the form `/nix/store/<hash>-<name>`.

cells.Read by: Steps of the jobs `wait-for-lab-cache`, `tron-build`, `test-host`, `test-fpga` and `benchmark` (`.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml`) and of the job `refresh` (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml`).
cells.Values and default: URL of a Nix binary cache (a server that holds finished Nix build results). Both workflows write `http://nix-store.positron.internal:5000`. Unset: does not occur. Both workflows define it.
cells.Effect: The jobs on the FPGA runners fetch the build plan (the Nix recipe and inputs of the Tron build) from this cache. They also fetch the prebuilt test and benchmark builds of Tron from it. The steps pass the URL as the option `--cache` or `--lab-cache` to `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py` and 3 more scripts. No script reads the name from the environment. The job `wait-for-lab-cache` waits until the cache holds the complete build plan. `bin/ci/nix-cache/test_cache.py` sets a `file://` address for a test.

cells.Values and default: Nix store path of the model traces (the files that the job `build-model-traces` exports for the test models). It is the output `store_path` of that job. Unset: does not occur. The job always defines it.
cells.Effect: The job fetches this store path from the Nix binary cache at `REGIONAL_NIX_CACHE` with `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py`. The plugin build (`nix/model-plugins-entry.nix`) gets the value as the Nix argument `modelTraces`. `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py` rejects text that is not a Nix store path of the form `/nix/store/<hash>-<name>`.

cells.Values and default: Path of a directory on the runner. The workflow writes `/opt/positron/weights/huggingface`. Unset: does not occur. The workflow always defines it.
cells.Effect: The steps pass it as `--weights-root` to `bin/ci/ingest/prepare_tests.py` and `bin/ci/model-traces/prepare_inputs.py`. The scripts check the Hugging Face model snapshots below this directory. They stop when a snapshot is missing or has the wrong version. The two scripts do not download models. `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py` downloads the snapshots. Its default directory is the same path.

cells.Values and default: Nix store path of the model plugins (the model code that ingest generates). It is the output `store_path` of the job `generate-plugins`. Unset: does not occur. The job always defines it.
cells.Effect: The job fetches this store path from the Nix binary cache at `REGIONAL_NIX_CACHE` with `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py`. The build recipe (`nix/tron-build.nix`) gets the value as the Nix argument `pluginBundle`. `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py` rejects text that is not a Nix store path of the form `/nix/store/<hash>-<name>`.

cells.Read by: Workflow steps that run `uv sync`, and the step that runs `make deb` (`.github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml`, `.github/workflows/gcp-nix.yml`, `.github/workflows/cpp-coverage.yml` and 2 more files)
cells.Values and default: Python version text with major, minor and patch numbers. All 5 workflows set `3.12.7`. Unset: no default exists. Each of the 5 workflows that read it defines it at workflow level.
cells.Effect: The steps pass it to `uv sync --python` (`uv` is the Python package tool). `uv` then builds the Python environment of that step with this version. `publish-deb.yml` passes it to `make deb` as `TOKENIZER_PYTHON_VERSION`. In `gcp-nix.yml` only job `benchmark-report` reads it. `bin/ci/lint-ci-pins.sh` reads the workflow text, not the environment. It fails when two workflows give different values, when a value lacks the patch number, or when a value differs from the `TOKENIZER_PYTHON_VERSION` default in `GNUmakefile`.

hints.problem: These counts are inventories of the tree at commit 7eddde7895. They will be wrong after the next unrelated merge that adds a reader of PATH or a workflow that sets UV_VERSION. The update rule does not catch such a merge, because the merge adds no variable and changes no default. A reviewer cannot check "and 39 more files" without repeating the scan. Line 35-36 already tells the reader to search the source to find every read, so the count adds nothing.
hints.suggested: In the 42 rows replace "and N more file(s)" with "and other files". In the 29 sentences remove the number, for example "All 5 workflows set `3.12.7`" becomes "Every workflow that sets it uses one value", and "Steps of the 7 workflows that set it" becomes "Steps of the workflows that set it". Change line 70 to: "4. Do not write line numbers or counts of files, tests, jobs or workflows. They\n   go stale."

hints.problem: The rows record pinned versions: Python 3.12.7, uv 0.9.5 and cabal 3.16.0.0. README.dependencies.md already records the same three pins and the steps to change them. .github/AGENTS.md lists README.dependencies.md and README.ci.md as the files to update when a pin changes. After this change a routine pin bump must also edit README.environment.md, and no check reports a miss.
hints.suggested: In the 5 rows replace the version number with a pointer, for example in PYTHON_VERSION: "Python version text with major, minor and patch numbers. [README.dependencies.md](README.dependencies.md) records the pinned value." Keep TRON_HOST_MIN_TRON as it is: its default `2.0.0~1tc6` is recorded nowhere else.

cells.Values and default: URL of a Nix binary cache. The workflow sets `http://10.202.0.10:5000`. No script checks the text. Unset: no default exists. The workflow defines it at workflow level.
cells.Effect: Four steps pass it to `bin/ci/nix-cache/acquire.py --cache`. The script copies one Nix store path from this cache with `nix copy --from`. The paths are outputs of the jobs `build-ingest`, `build-model-traces` and `generate-plugins`. No script reads the name from the environment. `acquire.py` repeats a failed copy until 2700 seconds (45 minutes) have passed. It waits up to 15 seconds between two attempts. After the 2700 seconds it stops with `Could not acquire`.

cells.Read by: Steps `Validate refresh invocation` and `Select runner matrix` of job `plan` (`.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml`)
cells.Values and default: `all`, `2x96core` or `2x72core`. Other text stops `bin/ci/bench-refresh-ci.sh validate-invocation` with `unknown runner class` and exit status 1. Unset: job `plan` always defines it. The value is `all` when the workflow input `runner_class` is empty, as on a scheduled run.
cells.Effect: Selects the runner classes (groups of CI servers of one type) that the Slice cost-data refresh measures. `all` selects `2x96core`, and also `2x72core` when `SLICE_REFRESH_2X72_ENABLED` is `true`. Unless `SLICE_REFRESH_2X72_ENABLED` is `true`, the value `2x72core` stops the job with `2x72core refreshes are disabled`. The steps pass the value as a command-line argument. No script reads the name from the environment.
